facts.fact: The Corporate Affairs Commission says companies register on its Company Registration Portal, at no cost for the tax number.

The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax identification number is generated automatically upon incorporation and endorsed on the certificate, the two agencies having fully integrated the service.

NGA.note: Document concerns the tax number, not the national ID number.

facts.fact: The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax identification number is electronically generated and endorsed instantly on certificates of newly registered entities.
The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax number is issued automatically at business incorporation through the Company Registration Portal, the two agencies' service being fully integrated.
